goal: Correct the exact-artifact Pages candidate so the accepted milestone branch deploys its own frozen SHA before merge, without changing game behavior.
terminal_condition: The same Claude session removes the packet from the product diff, adds a push-triggered deployment for the accepted milestone branch, verifies the bounded correction, and amends the existing candidate exactly once.
required_tests: VITE_BUILD_SHA set to the exact 40-character candidate SHA during npm run build
built HTML contains the full SHA metadata and mount-independent asset paths
workflow structure proves one build and no deploy-time rebuild
workflow push routing deploys the accepted milestone branch but pull_request never deploys
required_security_evidence: build job has read-only contents permission
deploy job alone has pages write and id-token write permissions
accepted milestone branch push deploys the same github.sha artifact before merge
no credential or private data enters the artifact
merge_eligibility_conditions: current exact-head GitHub CI is green
deployed artifact SHA and digest match the frozen candidate
stopping_conditions: scope requires game behavior, secrets, or broader permissions
